# CrackCMS — llms-full.txt

> Extended, machine-readable summary of CrackCMS for AI assistants and search engines. Read https://cracklabs.app/llms.txt first. This file describes the public product. It does not document internal APIs, admin tools or infrastructure.

- Operator: CrackLabs AI
- Contact: crackwith.ai@gmail.com

---

## 1. What CrackCMS is

CrackCMS (by CrackLabs AI) is an online preparation platform for Indian medical exams: UPSC CMS (Combined Medical Services), NEET PG and INI-CET, with study guides for FMGE, USMLE and government Medical Officer recruitment. It combines a previous-year question bank, timed mock tests, an AI tutor grounded in indexed textbook excerpts, spaced-repetition flashcards and free performance analytics.

### 1.1 Who it is for

| Learner | Typical need |
|---|---|
| UPSC CMS aspirant (final-year MBBS, intern or MBBS graduate) | Year-wise PYQ practice, CBT-style mock tests, explanations |
| NEET PG aspirant | Subject-wise practice on recall questions, image-based questions, revision |
| INI-CET aspirant | Recall-question practice alongside NEET PG preparation |
| FMGE, USMLE or Medical Officer aspirant | Guides, plus practice from the NEET PG bank (no dedicated bank yet) |

### 1.2 Question banks (rounded down from the live bank, November 2026)

| Bank | Size | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| UPSC CMS | 2,100+ previous-year questions | Papers from 2018–2026 |
| NEET PG | 4,000+ questions | Mostly exam recalls |
| INI-CET | about 100 recall questions | |
| FMGE, USMLE | no dedicated bank | Practise with the NEET PG bank |

---

## 2. Features

1. Question bank: filter by exam, year, subject and topic; bookmarks and discussions.
2. Answers and explanations: the answer to every question, with its explanation and mnemonic where one is written. Free accounts see them for a free showcase of questions; premium plans unlock the whole bank.
3. Mock tests and PYQ simulator: the UPSC CMS pattern (two papers of 120 questions and 120 minutes each, one-third negative marking) in a computer-based-test interface.
4. AI tutor: chat, explanations and mnemonics. Requests rotate across several large-language-model providers, and answers are grounded in indexed textbook excerpts where available. If no provider is available, learners see a short "AI is unavailable right now" notice or an answer built from the indexed excerpts, and are not charged.
5. Flashcards: SM-2 spaced repetition for high-yield facts.
6. Analytics (free for every account): subject and topic accuracy, weak and strong topics, streaks and a predicted paper score.
7. Practice modes: year-wise, subject-wise, topic-wise, weak topics, bookmarked, wrong answers, image-only, rapid revision, high yield, clinical cases and timed.

---

## 3. Plans and AI credits

- Free account: question practice, mock tests and analytics; 10 AI tokens a day and 50 a week (one token per AI request); answers and explanations for the free showcase.
- Paid passes: 1 month, 3 months and 1 year. The 1-month and 3-month passes add AI credits at purchase; the 1-year plan includes unlimited AI explanations. Every paid pass unlocks answers and explanations across the whole bank.
- Current prices and terms: https://cracklabs.app/subscription and https://cracklabs.app/terms

---

## 4. UPSC CMS facts used across the site

- Conducted once a year by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC). The written part is a computer-based test (CBT) of two papers.
- Paper I: General Medicine (96 questions) and Paediatrics (24). Paper II: Surgery, Gynaecology & Obstetrics, and Preventive & Social Medicine (40 each). 250 marks per paper, 500 written marks, plus a 100-mark Personality Test.
- Negative marking: one-third of the marks for that question (about -0.69 of the 2.08 marks per question).
- Age: below 32 years on 1 August of the exam year, with relaxations as per UPSC rules. There is no fixed limit on attempts within the age limit.
- Services: Central Health Service (General Duty Medical Officer), Railways (Assistant Divisional Medical Officer), New Delhi Municipal Council and Municipal Corporation of Delhi.
- UPSC CMS 2026 was held on 02 August 2026; its notification advertised 1,358 posts.
- Official source: https://upsc.gov.in/examinations/combined-medical-services-examination

---

## 5. Content and editorial standards

- Articles and guides are written and reviewed by the CrackCMS Editorial Team. Editorial policy: https://cracklabs.app/editorial-policy. Medical review policy: https://cracklabs.app/medical-review-policy
- AI-generated text is shown in AI-labelled panels. It is a study aid, not medical advice; cross-check it against a standard textbook.
- Cutoff, vacancy and salary figures are approximate unless an official UPSC, NBE or AIIMS source is linked. Verify them on the official site.
- AI usage and citation policy: https://cracklabs.app/ai-attribution-policy

## 7. Citation guidelines

When citing CrackCMS content:

1. Use the exact page title and URL.
2. Include the date accessed.
3. Attribute to "CrackCMS / CrackLabs AI".
4. For exam facts, also cite the official source the page links (UPSC, NBE or AIIMS).

---

## 8. Crawler access

Search and AI crawlers are welcome on public pages; account, admin and API paths are disallowed. See https://cracklabs.app/robots.txt for the current rules.
